title: </sub>  Require repeated original-fixture comparison runs
text:
</sub>  Require repeated original-fixture comparison runs

The fresh text added after the earlier baseline-comparability comment requires only “a separate run.” Elsewhere the spec defines one run as one recall observation and explicitly rejects single-run evidence because identical runs varied from 6–8/13, so one original-fixture observation cannot establish comparability with the historical five-run baseline. Specify the sweep configurations and a repeated sample count (at least the historical five runs); otherwise an implementation can satisfy AC8 with one stochastic result and still label the subset baseline-comparable.
